title: Stricter rules for pedestrian-related incidents effective Oct. 5 — LTO
summary: The Land Transportation Office's (LTO) September 29 memorandum imposing stricter sanctions on motorists involved in incidents on pedestrian lanes officially took effect on Monday, October 5.
